about: A Zig library for reading and writing image files such as PNG, BMP and JPEG.

prs.title: 32-bit BMP images save with the right colors
prs.broken: Saving a 32-bit image as a BMP file wrote a header that did not match the pixel order. Some programs refused the file and others showed the colors swapped.
prs.changed: I made the header describe the pixels in the order they are actually written.
prs.matters: BMP files saved by the library open correctly in other programs.

prs.title: 24-bit BMP images of any width save and load correctly
prs.broken: BMP files need each row padded to a multiple of 4 bytes. The library skipped that, so images of other widths saved as broken files and loaded skewed.
prs.changed: I made it add the padding when saving and skip it when loading.
prs.matters: Images of any width now go in and out of BMP files intact.

prs.title: Odd-width color PCX images with black in them read correctly
prs.broken: Reading odd-width color PCX images skipped every zero byte, not just the padding. Any pixel with no red, green or blue came out garbled, even in files the library wrote itself.
prs.changed: I made it skip the padding by its place in the row instead of by its value.
prs.matters: PCX images of any width load with their true colors.

prs.title: Odd-width Sun raster images no longer come out slanted
prs.broken: Sun raster rows are padded to an even length. The reader only knew that for black and white images, so other images with odd rows came out slanted.
prs.changed: I made it count the padding at every color depth and leave it out of the pixels.
prs.matters: Sun raster files of any width load the way ImageMagick shows them.

prs.title: Black and white fax-style TIFF images load without crashing
prs.broken: Black and white TIFFs using fax-style compression, as Pillow and ImageMagick write them, crashed the reader. Some others came out inverted.
prs.changed: I made each row start fresh, read to its true end, and decode black and white the way the main TIFF library does.
prs.matters: Common scanned documents and fax images now open, and match other tools pixel for pixel.

prs.title: Grayscale TIFFs where white is zero no longer load as negatives
prs.broken: Some grayscale TIFFs store white as zero. The reader ignored that for 8-bit images, so they loaded as negatives.
prs.changed: I made the reader flip the values for those images after decoding.
prs.matters: These grayscale files, which ImageMagick can write, now look right.

prs.title: Compressed TGA images without a footer load
prs.broken: Compressed TGA images saved without the optional footer, as ImageMagick writes them, failed to load unless their size happened to be a round number.
prs.changed: The decoder now stops at the real end of the file instead of reading past it.
prs.matters: Images that other viewers open load in apps using this library too.

prs.title: Unsupported TIFF compression returns an error, not a crash
prs.broken: Opening a TIFF with a compression the library does not decode, such as the JPEG kind scanners write, crashed the program.
prs.changed: Unknown compression types now return an unsupported error.
prs.matters: Apps can tell users a file is not supported instead of crashing.
